canyon.title: Found a Stripe Access Token, posing a risk to payment processing services and sensitive financial data
canyon.problem: Found a Stripe Access Token, posing a risk to payment processing services and sensitive financial data. stripe-access-token has detected secret for file apps/web/src/lib/payments.ts.
canyon.fix: Rotate this credential — it has been in your code. If nothing reads it, delete it from the code; otherwise store the new one with canyon secret set STRIPE_ACCESS_TOKEN and read it from the environment.
canyon.required_end_state: gitleaks no longer reports stripe-access-token for this code when it runs again, and the app still does what it did.
do_not: Silence it in gitleaks's settings or with an ignore comment — Canyon does not read those.
Remove or rename the flagged code just so the tool stops matching it.
